description: Adapter-based calendar coordination with user-selectable and multi-calendar backends, including macOS Calendar.app (JXA) and authenticated Google Workspace (gws)

capabilities.description: Lists calendars through the selected backend (JXA on macOS or authenticated gws)
Lists events for specific calendars within a date range
Queries busy windows for one or more calendars
Derives available slots from free/busy windows, timezone, working hours, and business calendar
Creates a new event through the selected calendar backend
Reschedules or updates an event, including its reminder, through an adapter capability
Deletes an event through an adapter capability
